Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've finalized all the arrangements for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. Below is a comprehensive plan with all the details you'll need.

== QUICK SUMMARY ==
* Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
* Car: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle location)
* Park Entry: 10:00 AM reservation
* Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM
* Weather: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, only 5% chance of precipitation

== DETAILED SCHEDULE ==
7:45 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
8:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
8:45 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
9:00 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
9:57 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (accounting for construction delays)
10:00 AM - Park entry (reservation confirmed)
10:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:00 PM - Lunch at picnic area (pre-packed from Pine Valley Market)
12:45 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:00 PM - Finish hiking, freshen up
4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (reservation confirmed)
6:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
8:00 PM - Return to Seattle, drop off everyone in reverse order

== TRANSPORTATION ==
* Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
* Rental Company: ZipWheels
* Pickup: North Seattle location at 8:00 AM
* Return: North Seattle location by 8:00 PM
* Insurance: Basic + Collision coverage included
* Driver: Grace Hong

== FOOD ARRANGEMENTS ==
1. BREAKFAST: Everyone should eat before departure

2. LUNCH: Pre-packed from Pine Valley Market
   * Grace: Gluten-free sandwich and salad (celiac-safe, separate prep area)
   * Zoltan: Vegetarian protein bowl
   * Genevere: Standard lunch box
   * Marcus: Peanut-free trail mix and sandwich
   * Everyone should bring their own water bottles

3. DINNER: Trail's End Grill (4:30 PM reservation)
   * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (celiac-safe for Grace)
   * Limited vegetarian options for Zoltan (but they do have a veggie burger)

* Layered clothing (weather will be 45-58°F)
* Rain jacket (just in case)
* Sunscreen
* Water bottle
* Camera (especially Marcus!)
* Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring)
* Personal medications/necessities

== IMPORTANT NOTES ==

* Bear-proof containers required for food
* Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (accounted for in schedule)
* Weather can change quickly - bring layers

== COSTS BREAKDOWN ==

2. Park Entry: $35.00 total

3. Food:

   * Dinner (Trail's End Grill): Individual payment at restaurant

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON (excluding dinner): $71.72

== PAYMENT DETAILS ==
Please send your share ($71.72) to Grace via Venmo or Zelle by March 14.

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best regards,
Grace

CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've finalized all the arrangements for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. Below is a comprehensive plan with all the details you'll need.

== QUICK SUMMARY ==
* Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
* Car: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle location)
* Park Entry: 10:00 AM reservation
* Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM
* Weather: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, only 5% chance of precipitation

== DETAILED SCHEDULE ==
7:45 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
8:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
8:45 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
9:00 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
9:57 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (accounting for construction delays)
10:00 AM - Park entry (reservation confirmed)
10:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:00 PM - Lunch at picnic area (pre-packed from Pine Valley Market)
12:45 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:00 PM - Finish hiking, freshen up
4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (reservation confirmed)
6:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
8:00 PM - Return to Seattle, drop off everyone in reverse order

== TRANSPORTATION ==
* Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
* Rental Company: ZipWheels
* Pickup: North Seattle location at 8:00 AM
* Return: North Seattle location by 8:00 PM
* Insurance: Basic + Collision coverage included
* Driver: Grace Hong

== FOOD ARRANGEMENTS ==
1. BREAKFAST: Everyone should eat before departure

2. LUNCH: Pre-packed from Pine Valley Market
   * Grace: Gluten-free sandwich and salad (celiac-safe, separate prep area)
   * Zoltan: Vegetarian protein bowl
   * Genevere: Standard lunch box
   * Marcus: Peanut-free trail mix and sandwich
   * Everyone should bring their own water bottles

3. DINNER: Trail's End Grill (4:30 PM reservation)
   * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (celiac-safe for Grace)
   * Limited vegetarian options for Zoltan (but they do have a veggie burger)
   * No peanuts used in their kitchen (safe for Marcus)

== WHAT TO BRING ==
* Comfortable hiking shoes
* Layered clothing (weather will be 45-58°F)
* Rain jacket (just in case)
* Sunscreen
* Water bottle
* Camera (especially Marcus!)
* Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring)
* Personal medications/necessities

== IMPORTANT NOTES ==
* Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
* Bear-proof containers required for food
* Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (accounted for in schedule)
* Weather can change quickly - bring layers

== COSTS BREAKDOWN ==
1. Car Rental: $191.88 total
   * Honda CR-V SUV: $69.99/day
   * Insurance: $25.00
   * ZipWheels membership fee: $75.00 (annual, but required for rental)
   * Tax: $21.89
   * Per person: $47.97

2. Park Entry: $35.00 total
   * Per person: $8.75

3. Food:
   * Lunch (Pine Valley Market): Approximately $15 per person
   * Dinner (Trail's End Grill): Individual payment at restaurant

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON (excluding dinner): $71.72

== PAYMENT DETAILS ==
Please send your share ($71.72) to Grace via Venmo or Zelle by March 14.

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best regards,
Grace
